## Personality

Minnie Andrews is described as a model pupil. Despite this, she is considered dull, poky, and never seems to have a good time.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P2](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0002)_

## History

Minnie Andrews was a classmate of [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) who welcomed her back when she returned to school after being forbidden from playing with [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md). She observed [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) channel her focus into her studies as [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) engaged in an intense academic rivalry with [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P0](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0000), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P14](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0014), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P17](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0017), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P36](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0036)_
